name: Nightly Vulnerability Guard
description: Scans critical vulnerabilities for sample-app and auto-creates a fix branch + PR

steps.name: Scan Critical Vulns
steps.question: Show critical vulnerabilities for the sample-app backend (APP_ID 100000001). Only show packages from pom.xml with safe versions available.

steps.name: Auto Fix & PR
steps.question: For the top fixable critical vulnerability found, create branch ai-agent/auto-fix-nightly on fork your-username/sample-app. Use patch_file to update the version in pom.xml, then create a Pull Request.
